title: Add Polls UI with React Query hooks (create, vote, and percentage results)

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks for polls (list, detail, create, vote) with immediate cache updates and clear English errors.
acceptanceCriteria: There are React Query hooks that wrap the new backend poll APIs.
After creating a poll, the polls list updates without a manual reload.
After voting, the poll’s displayed vote counts/percentages update without a manual reload.
Errors are surfaced as clear English messages (e.g., not signed in).

file_operations.description: Extend the typed backend interface with poll-related types (Poll, PollId, etc.) and methods (createPoll, getPoll, getAllPolls, votePoll) so new React Query hooks can compile against the backend capabilities.

Add poll React Query hooks: useGetAllPolls, useGetPoll, useCreatePoll, useVotePoll. Ensure create/vote mutations update the cache by invalidating and/or updating ['polls'] and ['poll', pollId] query keys. Surface authorization and other failures as clear English Error messages. Use the selected 'authorization' component’s frontend guidance for authenticated vs guest behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a Polls page with poll list (newest first), signed-in-only creation form (2+ options), and voting UI that shows percentage results; guests can browse and see an English sign-in prompt for create/vote.
acceptanceCriteria: A Polls route/page exists and is reachable from the main navigation.
Guests can view the polls list and per-poll results UI but cannot vote or create; the UI shows an English sign-in prompt.
Signed-in users can create a poll (question + at least 2 options).
Signed-in users can vote on a poll; after voting, the UI shows percentages for each option (and handles 0 total votes gracefully).
The UI prevents creating polls with fewer than 2 non-empty options and prevents voting without selecting an option, with clear English feedback.

file_operations.description: Create the Polls page that composes existing shadcn/ui components (e.g., Card, Button, Input, Label, Alert) to render: (1) polls list (newest first via useGetAllPolls), (2) a create-poll form gated to authenticated users, and (3) per-poll voting UI with computed percentages and graceful 0-vote handling. Use the selected 'shadcn-ui' component library for consistent UI composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Use the selected 'authorization' component’s frontend guidance (Internet Identity state) to show guest prompts and disable create/vote when unauthenticated; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a reusable PollCard component used by PollsPage to display a single poll: question, options, current totals/percentages, and voting controls. Implement local selection state, validation (must select an option before voting), and call useVotePoll; ensure the UI updates immediately via React Query cache updates. Use the selected 'shadcn-ui' components for layout and feedback; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register the new /polls route in the TanStack Router route tree and wire it to PollsPage so it is navigable.

Add a main navigation link to /polls (with an appropriate icon) so the Polls page is reachable from the primary app navigation. Use existing shadcn/ui Button-asChild Link pattern; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
